Hi Samira —

Appreciate the details and the doc. I've attached a compact proposal and an itemized pricing sheet (pilot and scale paths). Key points up front so you can circulate to procurement: 

1) One-time implementation (evidence collection, KMS integration, HSM provisioning planning): $75,000
   - Includes SOC2 evidence handoff, checklist, and 2 remediation sprints.
2) Recurring (monthly):
   - Audit logs: $0.025 per 1k events for 90-day retention; $0.05 per 1k for 365-day; $0.09 per 1k for 730-day (tiered).
   - KMS integration: $2,500/month for BYOK support + $1,250/month per HSM seat (optional).
   - Residency surcharge (US-only vs EU): +12% recurring on compute/hosting when deploying EU region; migration assistance as one-time planning fee ($12k).
3) Pilot credits: we can provide a $15,000 pilot credit that offsets the one-time implementation for pilots under 6 months.
4) Commit options: with a 12-month committed spend of $120k we can offer a 30% credit on the implementation line and a 10% discount on recurring for year one.

Lead times: HSM seat provisioning ~6–8 weeks after SOW/PO; BYOK KMS integration typically 2–3 weeks.

I attached the proposal PDF and the pricing sheet. Can procurement send the PO template and target signature timeline? If you like, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk procurement through billing flows and evidence delivery cadence.

Attachments: [HL_proposal_20280730.pdf (pdf), pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HIPAA compliance packaging — internal concession proposal

Monica / team —

Quick internal note on concession flexibility if HealthLine needs a cleaner procurement path:

- Proposal A (standard): $75k one-time + listed recurring rates.
- Proposal B (commit-backed concession): If HL signs 12-month minimum commit >= $120k ARR, we apply a 30% credit to the implementation fee (effective credit $22,500) and 10% off recurring for year 1.
- Proposal C (pilot-first, low friction): For pilots that cannot commit up front, offer a $15k pilot credit + 3 months waived on audit log ingestion fees (to accelerate proof-of-value).

Also propose splitting residency-related charges into: (a) a one-time migration planning fee (we hold $12k), (b) a usage surcharge for EU-hosted compute. This avoids over-indexing implementation credits against long-term residency costs.

If we want to lower friction further for procurement, I can approve the following with Monica's sign-off: increase pilot credit to $20k (internal chargeback to pre-sales) and guarantee HSM provisioning SLA of 6 weeks. Otherwise keep the 30% implementation credit for commit deals.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
